item.title: Georgetown County completes airport runway renovation project
item.description: GEORGETOWN COUNTY, S.C. (WCBD) – Georgetown County has completed a major improvement project with the reconstruction of the secondary runway at the Georgetown County Airport. The upgraded runway 11/29, originally built during World War II, had developed significant surface and drainage issues over the years. It had not been resurfaced in more than two decades. [...]
